newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thailand approves investment for 2nd Laos bridge.
newsitem.headline: Thailand approves investment for 2nd Laos bridge.

text.p: Thailand's council of economic ministers on Monday approved a proposal to invest about 400-500 million baht ($16-$20 million) to build a second bridge between Laos and Thailand, a government official said.
Laos would seek funds from Japan, South Korea and Australia to match the Thai investment, an official at the Office of the National Economic and Social Development Board told reporters.
The proposed bridge would link Thailand's Mukdahan province, about 650 km (406 miles) northeast of Bangkok, and Savannakhet in Laos, he said.
The first bridge across the lower Mekong, between the Thai town of Nong Khai and Laos's capital Vientiane, was financed by Australia and opened in 1994.
